lines.2: 「Summer is truly beginning now. We should buy a wind chime. They are wonderful.」
lines.3: 「--That's what Otome said. What do you think?」
lines.4: 「I don't need a wind chime if we have air conditioning.」
lines.7: 「That's unseemly for a lady. Didn't you eat breakfast?」
lines.8: 「What the hell? You're the one who rushed me, Leo!」
lines.9: 「Tch. Fine. I'll bestow some juice upon you.」
lines.12: She's infuriating. I'll have her executed.
lines.23: 「Someone from Yuihama Academy came again. It sounds like they're negotiating.」
lines.25: 「Is Date really that fast? What does he run the hundred meters in?」
lines.26: 「I think Subaru runs it in a little over ten seconds.」
lines.28: 「Well, Subaru's main event is the eight hundred, so the hundred doesn't show what he can really do.」
lines.29: Coming during class was a nuisance.
lines.31: He must have bought some dating sim on Friday and stayed home to play it.
lines.33: --Fourth period's class in another room ended.
lines.36: Crab was gone from her seat. She had clearly eaten it and fled.
lines.37: I'd make her cry three times or so later. Right now, I needed food.
lines.38: And since I'd forgotten my wallet, I had no money.
lines.39: Maybe I could get something from someone in class.
lines.40: No. Owing any of these people would be dangerous.
lines.41: This was the loser class, after all. They were a pretty shameless bunch.
lines.42: Even the kindhearted Yoshimi wasn't here.
lines.44: I could stave off starvation with the snacks in the student council room.
lines.47: 「My, my. You caught me at an embarrassing moment.」
lines.48: 「I'm actually trying to save my allowance, so I thought I would make lunch out of the snacks here.」
lines.49: Th-That's awfully stingy for a teacher.
lines.50: 「Inori buys far too much without planning ahead.」
lines.51: 「Mr. Tsuchinaga, I cannot afford your food for a while, so please hunt for yourself.」
lines.52: 「Good heavens! You would have an aristocrat such as myself imitate savages!?」
lines.53: 「Well then, I shall eat in the faculty room.」
lines.55: 「It cannot be helped. Inori, share some of those snacks. Truthfully, I would prefer yakitori. It is delicious.」
lines.57: Mr. Tsuchinaga really was a formidable bird...
